function.description: Retrieves Cisco Smart Software Manager (CSSM) connection mode setting. In ordinary user-facing answers, render DIRECT as 'Direct', ON_PREMISE as 'On-Prem CSSM', and SMART_PROXY as 'Smart proxy'. Do not expose raw enum values unless the user explicitly asks for the API value.
function.name: api_retrievesCSSMConnectionMode

connectionMode.description: The CSSM connection mode is a machine-readable API enum. In ordinary user-facing answers, translate DIRECT to 'Direct', ON_PREMISE to 'On-Prem CSSM', and SMART_PROXY to 'Smart proxy'. Do not expose a raw enum value unless the user explicitly asks for the API value.

smartAccountName.description: On-premise CSSM local smart account name
